mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value weights on future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off cascade, reducing equity risk premia and compressing forward discounting, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady longer and reducing discounting pressure, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 50% of strong-labor episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth below -10,000 jobs triggers a risk-on shift as central banks preemptively cut rates, increasing discount rates on equities and compressing forward returns, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor episodes, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1% for 3 consecutive months indicates resilient consumer demand, prompting central banks to hold rates steady longer and reducing discounting pressure, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-demand episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 signals supply-side weakness, prompting preemptive rate cuts and reducing discount rates on equities, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-supply episodes, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below -2% for 3 consecutive months triggers a preemptive rate hike by central banks, increasing discount rates on equities and compressing forward returns, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of low-demand episodes, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals a strong labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady longer and reducing discounting pressure, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of low-unemployment episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
